note: Official statutory reference frameworks approved for legal context across Aviation, E-Commerce, General CPA 2019, and Insurance.

sources.review_note: IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders' Interests, operations and allied matters of insurers) Regulations, 2024 Gazette text approved for insurance turnaround times, 30-day settlement, penal interest, and grievance redressal.
DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Parts II (Refunds), IV (Cancellations, Delays, Denied Boarding), and VI (Lost Baggage up to ₹20,000 / Carriage by Air Act, 1972) approved for aviation grievances.
Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 (Rules 4 and 6 return refusal prohibition) approved for online seller and platform grievances.
Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Sections 2(11) deficiency, 2(47) unfair trade practice, and Chapter VI Product Liability) approved for statutory claims and fallback context.
